synopsis: SODA is a 2022 construction dataset containing 19,846 images across 15 classes [f5847, f12812]. Chapter 13 independently repeats the image count, with no numerical disagreement across the supplied facts [f10825, f5847, f12812]. The glossary describes SODA and MOCS as image-only datasets captured from fixed or aerial viewpoints, rather than from a machine-mounted multi-sensor rig; this limits their match to that sensing configuration [f12813].
